description: The public lookup reports the original-source amount to consensus-unit conversion for the BAFU cases in issue 382. These claims exercise exact source identifiers. Unit tests also exercise name-based and algorithmic lookup, preparation and recorded special multipliers.

expectations.title: BAFU Uranium alpha amounts in Bq are converted to kBq
expectations.comment: Issue 382 reports the September 22 build places Bq rows on kBq flows. The unit table defines a ratio of 0.001, which lookup previously omitted. Verified through the public lookup against Zenodo 22857950, run 20260920T1042228874600000; the archive records a dirty producer revision, so this does not establish a reproducible full-build comparison.

expectations.title: BAFU passenger car noise amounts in km are converted to m
expectations.comment: Issue 382 identifies this length conversion. The source quantity is multiplied by 1000, not divided by it. Verified through the public lookup against Zenodo 22857950, run 20260920T1042228874600000; the archive records a dirty producer revision, so this does not establish a reproducible full-build comparison.

expectations.title: BAFU waste heat amounts in kWh are converted to MJ
expectations.comment: Issue 382 identifies this energy conversion. Ordinary unit scales are computed from units.json rather than written as new source-specific rulings. Verified through the public lookup against Zenodo 22857950, run 20260920T1042228874600000; the archive records a dirty producer revision, so this does not establish a reproducible full-build comparison. The selector uses the stored canonical notation kwh; caller spelling kWh is covered by the lookup regression tests.
